stories.title: Follow live: Rays trim Brewers’ lead on RBI groundout
Brewers' Misiorowski unleashes 103.5 mph pitch to set World Series record
stories.summary: Jacob Misiorowski broke the record for fastest World Series pitch with the very first offering of this year's Fall Classic.

stories.title: Fever fire GM Cox amid front office shake-up; White expected back, per sources
stories.summary: The Fever fired general manager Amber Cox on Friday, hours after the team announced that president Kelly Krauskopf stepped down. As of now, the expectation is that Stephanie White will remain Indiana's coach, sources told ESPN's Alexa Philippou.

stories.title: Manfred: Small-market World Series good for game, but cap still needed
stories.summary: MLB commissioner Rob Manfred said a Rays-Brewers World Series is good for the game but stressed that small markets can't compete on a regular basis without a cap.

stories.title: Oregon State standout WR Legree re-signs with Beavers for '27
stories.summary: Oregon State freshman receiver Jesse Legree, one of the country's breakout stars in 2026, has re-signed with the Beavers for next season, he announced Friday.
